items: PM Modi inaugurates "Param Pragya" supercomputer — IIT Delhi's Sonipat campus, Haryana. 🎯 Don't confuse with Param Shakti (IIT Madras, earlier 2026).
Prakriti Gyan Dham — CSIR-NBRI's 1st Eco-Educational Hub, Banthra, Lucknow.
Himalayan Chandra Telescope (Hanle, Ladakh) marks 25 years — operated by IIA, named after Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar, under DST.
INST Mohali + BARC — nanobots for breast cancer therapy.
I4C advisory — "Boss Scam"/CEO Impersonation Fraud (WhatsApp Web hijack via Trojan) — I4C helpline "1930," handle "CyberDost."
IBM partners with MIT Bengaluru & CHRIST University — 2 AI centres.
NVIDIA + 35 firms — "Open Secure AI Alliance" — notably absent: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta.
IN-SPACe — India's 1st mandatory space object re-entry framework — casualty risk cap 1 in 10,000.
LegRAA & Digital Courts 2.1 — AI tools for judiciary; LegRAA trained on 36,000+ SC judgments; both in pilot phase (₹53.57 Cr earmarked).
World's largest electric aircraft completes first flight — Heart Aerospace X1 (Sweden-founded), maiden flight New York.
